name: Tax Report
query:
SELECT
    emp.name AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:100",
    emp.employee_name AS "Employee Name::300",
    emp.branch AS "Branch:Link/Branch:120",
    emp.department AS "Department:Link/Department:250",
    ssa.base AS "Base Salary:Currency:120",
    ssa.base * 0.06 AS "Salary Tax:Currency:120"
FROM `tabEmployee` emp
INNER JOIN `tabSalary Structure Assignment` ssa
    ON ssa.employee = emp.name
    AND ssa.docstatus = 1
    AND ssa.from_date = (
        SELECT MAX(s2.from_date)
        FROM `tabSalary Structure Assignment` s2
        WHERE s2.employee = emp.name
          AND s2.docstatus = 1
          AND s2.from_date <= CURDATE()
    )
WHERE emp.status = 'Active'
  AND IFNULL(emp.base_salary_only, 0) = 0
ORDER BY emp.name
